name: SM_Barrel_Oak_PR
supersedes: Stonebrook/SM_Barrel_Oak_01 (0.84 x 0.84 x 1.01 m, base_center) and the family binding of class barrel (97 placements)
dresses: coopered oak barrel, 0.84 m at the bilge, 1.0 m: twenty separate staves of uneven width with gaps, five-board heads sawn round and set in the croze, four driven hoops a touch out of level with riveted laps (baked), a bung; true-metal hoops with rust, handling grease and a damp tide mark at the foot

fit.size: same height and bilge as SM_Barrel_Oak_01
fit.states: the broken frames 2-6 (the barrel being smashed) are not built: keep the existing break effect

build: DINK_PP=<PhotorealPass> blender -b -t 4 --python Props/tools/props_bake.py -- <asset>; then blender -b Props/_build/Props.blend --python Props/tools/props_merge.py
status: round 2: unique bake, reviewed; not claimed photoreal where known_weaknesses lists faults
material_exception: unique bake (T_<Asset>_BC/_N/_ORM and _E where listed), private to this prop, not a row of ART_STANDARD.md section 2: the coordinator asked for sculpted or displaced high-detail sources baked to the game mesh with AO and curvature edge wear, true metal in ORM.B and emissive masks, which the shared tiling library cannot carry. Non-overlapping UV0; no vertex colour.
known_weaknesses: Round 2 unique bake, three review rounds (r6). Last look still faults: the joints between staves are drawn as even dark lines (AO dirt) rather than varying gaps; rust runs under the hoops are faint; the hoops are flat strap with baked rivets at the lap only; head boards have no chalk or brand marks; the chime is not undercut. Broken states not built.
